item.title: How to study Islam — the Quran and Sunnah as sources, a student's approach
item.description: A structured introduction to Islamic theology, jurisprudence, and Quranic study methods. item.title: Aqidah — the six articles of faith explained
item.description: Lesson 2: Aqidah — the six articles of faith explained This lesson teaches the six articles of faith (aqidah) that form the foundation of Islamic theology: belief in God, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and divine decree. Muslims consider these the non-negotiable core of the…

item.title: The Quran — structure, major themes, reading with understanding
item.description: Lesson 3: The Quran — structure, major themes, reading with understanding This lesson teaches you the structure of the Quran, its major themes, and practical methods for reading it with understanding rather than just moving your eyes across the page. item.title: The Seerah — key periods of the Prophet's life and their lessons
item.description: Lesson 4: The Seerah — key periods of the Prophet's life and their lessons This lesson teaches the key periods of the Prophet Muhammad's life (the Seerah) and the lessons Muslims draw from each. Muslims regard Muhammad as the final prophet and the living embodiment of the Quran's teachings — his…

item.description: Lesson 5: Fiqh essentials — the five pillars in practice This lesson teaches the five pillars of Islam — the core practices that structure a Muslim's religious life — and introduces fiqh, the Islamic science of law, as the framework that explains how these practices are performed. item.title: Daily worship made practical — prayer and fasting guides
item.description: Lesson 6: Daily worship made practical — prayer and fasting guides This lesson is the most hands-on in the course: a practical guide to the two pillars you will perform most often — the five daily prayers and the Ramadan fast. Read it slowly, practice each step, and use the Daily Worship Checklist…

item.title: Islamic ethics — character, family, and community
item.description: Lesson 7: Islamic ethics — character, family, and community This lesson teaches the Islamic framework of ethics: how belief translates into character (akhlaq), and what the tradition asks of Muslims toward family, neighbors, and the wider community. item.description: Lesson 8: Your study path — building a lifelong learning routine This final lesson helps you design a personal, sustainable study routine so that what you have learned in this course becomes the beginning of lifelong learning, not its end.
